en: Uno-san likes new girls at massage parlors. I should go to an info booth and find out which places have new staff.
Uno-san likes new girls at massage parlors. There are a couple of places with new staff. I'm looking for Boom and Bust as well as Resort Boing.
Uno likes new girls at massage parlors. There are a couple of places that have taken on new staff lately. I'll try Boom and Bust.
Uno-san likes new girls at massage parlors. I should ask at the info booth across the street from Boom and Bust to find out where Uno-san is.
Uno-san likes new girls at massage parlors. There are a couple of places that have taken on new staff lately. I'll check out Operation Panties as well as Rubbe and Tucke's.
Uno-san likes new girls at massage parlors. There are a couple of places that have taken on new staff lately. I'll try Rubbe and Tucke's.
Uno-san seemed pretty happy about earning more money to play around with. Okay, time to head back to his clinic.
Looks like I need to find out what Manabe-san was up to back then. I guess I'll take a taxi to Manabe-san's place, Yakiniku Ittoukai.
Looks like Uno-san was telling the truth. There was game fixing going on. I'd better go tell him.
Was he trying to kill us? I'd better catch him and find out.
Why would Sakai-san do that? I'd better get out of here in one piece if I want to find out.

Part 4, Chapter 2 Complete
On to Part 4, Chapter 3
So something changed this town 15 years ago. I'll head to Ushijima-san's place on Kumano Boulevard to get some answers.
Milky-chan's brother is in trouble? I need to get a taxi to Warehouse 62 at the Port of Nagoya, and fast!
I gotta help Uno-san before I go to the Port of Nagoya. Gotta go to his acupuncture clinic.
I'll leave Uno-san in Takasugi-san's hands, then head to Warehouse 62 at the Port of Nagoya by taxi.
Milky-chan mentioned Warehouse 62 on the phone. I gotta find it and slip inside.
I don't want to go down like this... Gotta find a way through.
Sorry, Manabe-san, there's no way I'm giving up now.

Part 4, Chapter 3 Complete
On to Part 4, Chapter 4
It'll be a while before that guy in the mask shows up. I guess I'll kill some time.
That masked guy is at my place already. I'd better head back quick.
If I can't take down Dojima-kun, I don't deserve to join him in Tokyo. I'd better give this everything I've got.
I don't have to head to Tokyo just yet. This is a good time to tie up any loose ends.
If I want to uncover everything that happened 15 years ago, I can't afford to lose here.

Part 4: Tatsuo Shinada complete
On to the Finale
I guess New Serena is my first stop. I hope the mama is there.
I'll head over to Stardust. Kazuki or Yuya might know something.
Time to lure them to the vacant lot opposite Public Park 3.
I can't lose here. This guy has information I need.
I'll go to New Serena and see what Baba has to say.
Baba is waiting outside New Serena. Once I'm done here, I'd better go hear him out.
Purgatory's my best bet for trackin' down Morinaga. Should be able to get there through the manhole in Children's Park.
I can get to Purgatory through the sewers below the manhole in Children's Park.
Purgatory hasn't changed a bit. The Florist should still be through the big doors at the end.
He said to come to the Underground Coliseum. I think it was in the middle of Purgatory, right? Better get a move on.
This guy needs a tune-up. Time to take the gloves off and show him what really matters.

Finale Chapter 1 Complete
On to Finale Chapter 2
I guess I'll have to head back to Sky Finance and regroup.
I'll have to see if the homeless around here can help me track down this event planner.
I have to find this event planner first. I guess I'll start by asking the homeless guys Akiyama-san mentioned.
I should stop by a convenience store and pick up some liquor as a gift.
I was supposed to stop by a convenience store and get some liquor as a gift.
The Hotel District is probably a good place to look. If I wander around, I'll probably run into someone.
Apparently a lot of homeless folks hang out around the Hotel District. That's where I should look.
I guess I'll wait until I hear something.
Looks like I'll have to wait until I hear back.
The building next to MEB on Shichifuku Street, huh? Let's take a look.
It was the building next to MEB on Shichifuku Street. I'll head there now.
What's up with these guys? Well, this is the building where MAO Inc. is, all right.
What's going on here? In any case, this is the building where MAO Inc. is!

Finale Chapter 2 Complete
On to Finale Chapter 3
Katsuya is in Kamurocho Hills. Once everything's in order, it's time to make a move.
That Katsuya guy is in Kamurocho Hills. Better get ready, then get going.
I've got to fight my way through to get to Katsuya.
I've gotta break through to get to Katsuya. Failure isn't an option.
Looks like I have to get through this to find out what I need to know.
It ain't my day to die! I'm not goin' down 'til I get to the truth!
Never thought I'd have to go up against Saejima, but I'm not pulling any punches!
Goin' up against Kiryu wasn't in the plan, but this's gonna be a hell of a fight!

Finale Chapter 3 Complete
On to Finale Chapter 4
He said he'd be waiting at Public Park 3. I wonder what the message is?
Once I go back to training, I won't have another chance to get away before the concert. I should take care of anything else now.
So Kiryu went up to the roof? Gotta catch up and talk.
Guess I made everyone worry. I should head back to New Serena.

Finale Chapter 4 complete
On to Finale Final Chapter
I better finish up anything else I have left to do before tomorrow evening.
Better tie up any loose ends before tomorrow evening.
Didn't I have some unfinished business? I'd better get it done before tomorrow evening.
I've got until tomorrow night. If there's anything left to do, I'd better do it now.
I better finish up anything else I have left to do before this evening.
Better tie up any loose ends before this evening.
I'd better get any unfinished business done before this evening.
Tonight's the night. If there's anything left to do, I'd better do it now.
I should join everyone back at New Serena once I'm ready.
Guess I'll join everyone back at New Serena when I'm finished getting ready.
I'll join everyone back at New Serena once I'm ready.
I better join everyone back at New Serena when I'm ready.
I'm not letting anyone stop me here!
No way I'm going out like this!
I'm not letting anything stand in my way. They're going down!
Damn, where'd they all come from!? Time to give these guys a thrashing!
One-on-one with my sworn brother... Gotta give this everything I got!
Let's see if I can knock some sense into you with my fists!
They keep on coming... But there's no way I'm giving up!
There's no end to them. I'm not throwing in the towel though!
This won't end until I settle things with him. This time, I'll put him down for good!
This place is a mess. I'd better look inside.
Masato Aizawa. Let's settle this once and for all, just you and me!
You have completed Yakuza 5. Congratulations!
